summary: Add executable examples to iFood leaf commands and make feedback honor global dry-run semantics.
reason: The canonical full dogfood matrix requires every leaf help surface to include an executable example; the generated bm example also omitted required request-body flags.
validated_outcome: Every iFood-specific leaf command exposes a concrete Examples section, bm supplies its mandatory body flags, local credential imports and feedback are classified as local writes with dry-run examples, and four flagship commands provide executable credential-free example mode.
